title: Level 3 (Advanced) - C-16
notes:
West leads the ♠J against 6♥. West's lead is won in dummy. There is a possible loser in diamonds if the finesse is wrong. The trump suit is also a source of concern.

South should begin by taking the diamond finesse. If West wins the ♦K, South will have to play the trump suit for no losers. The only hope is a doubleton ♥Q. South should cash the ♥A and ♥K and hope for the best.

If the diamond finesse wins, South can afford a loser in trump. He should play to guard against 4 hearts to the ♥Q in West's hand. After cashing a top heart, South should continue a low heart towards dummy's ♥J. West will be unable to defeat the contract regardless of how he defends. Notice that cashing a second top honour will create a second trump loser on this lie of the cards.

Taking the diamond finesse before playing trump is an example of a discovery play. A discovery play involves testing the position in one suit (diamonds) to find out how to play another suit (hearts).
